notes: Corrected the εἰς τὸν οἶκον → home unit: the accepted alignment left εἰς unrepresented under rules 34 and 94, but rule 93 scopes the pleonastic arm to a governed adverb and denies it where the governed word is a noun and the single English word is an adverb. The preposition and the noun are now one aligned unit on home, headed on οἶκον, as ἐν τάχει → quickly is read at 1TI.3.14, REV.1.1, ROM.16.20 and LUK.18.8.
The article τόν is unrepresented either way, so the correction does not disturb it (rules 23 and 93).
All other units are unchanged; the two supplied possessives on τούς are the article's own under rule 20's second arm, no possessor standing in the Greek.
